coverage: 17 regions, 3 republican cities and the retained Baikonur special-status map unit. Current KATO register: 170 regional districts, 25 urban districts and 90 cities. 227 second-level polygons and 4 urban district polygons; the two Karaganda urban districts have official cards but no verified polygon. 48 district-level cities use settlement points. The 39 regional cities use their city-administration polygons (Baikonur remains at the first level).
processing: The existing first-level geometry, political geometry, context and international lines are retained byte-for-byte. District interiors reuse geokz 2024, with changed units replaced from OSM retrieved 16 November 2026. Each region is partitioned against its exact retained land geometry; every face has one owner, and lake cutouts and external borders are inherited. Shared internal edges are stored once. The shared regional renderer lazy-loads only the selected parent chunk. No duplicate country fill or separate renderer is added.

centralAsianFrontiers.method: The five Central Asian countries share one retained OpenStreetMap national partition, including all enclaves. Existing external land frontiers and lake shorelines are retained; Caspian territorial water is excluded. Subdivision fills conform to their country and parent; country contexts and international strokes use the same boundaries.
